title: The importance of social presence and motivation in distance learning
reason: Randomised control vs experimental (motivational e-mails) comparison of completion, final grade and Course Interest Survey scores in community-college online classes. Only group contrasts; no per-student platform indicator or activity product enters any analysis.

extraction.population: community-college students in 12 online classes, spring 2009
extraction.notes: Group membership is not an indicator. n not extracted (abstract does not give it).
